Al-Hamdulillah, millions of Muslims around the world have trusted us and we hope, insha'Allah, that it will give you complete satisfaction.

Beginner or more advanced, take advantage of more than 25 premium features around the Holy Book of Allah (al-Quran al-Kareem - القرآن الكريم)


------------
THE QURAN EVERYWHERE
------------

You can use the application as soon as it's installed without any restrictions! Once the audio files (mp3) downloaded to your device, no internet connection is required!

------------
AUDIO PLAY (mp3)
------------

• Listen and learn the recitation of the Qur'an with the greatest reciters (Qari / Sheikh / Imam) such as Mishary Alafasy, Saad Al-Ghamidi, As-Sudais or AbdulBasit AbdulSamad (Murattal, Mujawwad)

• Activate the fullscreen mode to only display the text (Arabic, English translation or phonetic) at the same time as the audio is playing back!

• Control the sound (pause / play / next / previous) from a bluetooth device or headset

• What if you receive a call while listening to the recitation of the Noble Quran? The audio will automatically pause to avoid having the playback at the same time as your interlocutor who is speaking

• Avoid having to take out your phone so as to go to the next Surah (سورة - which is a chapter) thanks to the AutoPlay feature

• Create as many playlists as you want: by Surah or from one given Ayah to another

------------
TRANSLATION
------------

• All 6236 Ayats (verses) are translated into many languages with different translations for English language

• For better comfort, the entire graphical interface is in English and many other languages like French, Spanish, Russian, Dutch, German or Indonesian

• Switch easily from one language to another (app + translation or only Quran's translation)

• Tafsir is also available

------------
LEARN SURAS AND/OR AYATS
------------

• Learn by doing repetition: for example, "repeat 5 times from verse 1 to verse 4 of Sura Yasin"

• If you can not read Arabic, 2 transcription systems are available! This will help you pronounce the words correctly

------------
ADAPT READING AS YOU WANT
------------

• Beyond the classical Quran decomposition in Surahs, you can access the Juz (جزء division in 30 equal parts) or the Hizb (حزب division in 60 equal parts) of your choice which is particularly convenient during the Ramadan month

• Take back to the last Ayah consulted thanks to the automatic bookmark

• To save an Aya and take notes, we have added a system of favorites accessible in a simple way.

• Show or hide the parts that you are not interested in: you want only Arabic text? Hide all the other elements! Perhaps you prefer to display the transcript and the translation instead? It's possible too!

• Each beginning of Surah will bring you information such as its order of revelation, its type (Meccan or Madani) and the translation of its title

• Improve your reading comfort by changing colors and sizes of the texts

• Also choose from several styles of writing (eg simple style or Uthmani)

• View texts as you want it to be: one above the other or side by side

------------
TAJWEED (recitation rules of the Holy Quran)
------------

• To help you with tajwid (تجويد), you have the possibility to activate a color code directly in the Arabic text

------------
COMMUNITY
------------

• Share any verse or note with your contacts

• Receive everyday a notification showing you an Ayat or a Hadith showing the beauty of Islam religion



May Allah swt accepts our deeds and may He guides us to the straight path. Ameen.
